_comment: Illustrated art the site may place on a page: ARCHV-drawn player portraits and ARCHV-designed club badges. Faces are illustrated-only by canon, and every badge here is our own typographic disc, never a club's real crest. Read through scripts/shared/illustrated.mjs (generators) or src/render/illustrated.ts (front page), never by hand-writing a path. TWO ASSET HOMES, both in this repo: public/media/illustrated/ holds the 320px front-page portraits and the badges (sources: fifa.archv/assets/headshots and fifa.archv/match-covers/carousel/assets/badges), and public/heads/ holds the 240px webp head bank the daily desk job commits and already cites in entry.image. Phase 2B banked the head-bank faces here so a card gets a portrait even on the days the desk filed no image field. Nothing new was generated for that first pass: every player below it was already drawn, already committed, and already named on this site. A player row may carry `aliases`, other names the desk uses for him (a surname on its own), and `aliasUnless`, the names of different people who share one; the aliases do not count in a text that names one of those. Both the site and the app pick the first banked player named, headline before standfirst (scripts/shared/illustrated.mjs); the app also needs an app-grade portrait, and takes a standfirst-only name only when the body names him too. An alias is switched off when the headline, standfirst or body names one of the row's aliasUnless.
_identity: Each head-bank entry's identity comes from two in-repo records that agree: the bank index at fifa.archv/player-headshot-bank.md, and the desk's own committed imageAlt for that same file in src/data/*.ts. A face with only one of the two is not listed. Deliberately NOT listed: /heads/ederson.webp, because the desk's Ederson is the Atalanta midfielder and a bare mononym would also match Manchester City's goalkeeper, who is a different Brazilian with a different face. A wrong face is worse than no face, so that one stays on the entries that name it by hand.

_hd: Every player also carries `hd`: the 600x600 app-grade portrait in public/heads/hd/, built from the full-resolution master by scripts/heads/normalize-heads.py to one framing, with the master and its identity check recorded in scripts/data/heads-hd.json. The iOS feed (scripts/build-feed.mjs via scripts/shared/app-art.mjs) serves `hd`, never `src`. The Manchester United rows that carry `club` instead of `nation` were added on 2026-09-11 from the 2026-09-10 squad table in fifa.archv/player-headshot-bank.md, where the first team was read from the FPL API and Wikipedia and each face is the named bank row's file with no kit flag. Matheus Cunha, Amad Diallo and Kobbie Mainoo joined on 2026-09-11 with new portraits in Manchester United red (founder order), replacing banked faces in national colours, which the 2026-08-04 kit guard forbids on a Manchester United label. The same batch added every player, driver and coach the desks had posted about more than once, across football, tennis, golf, Formula 1 and the NFL; each row's verifiedBy names its reference or bank row.
